listing.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Racing-8-DX-Recomp)
listing.summary: Racing-8-DX-Recomp uses your own Mario Kart 8 Deluxe game and 3.0.4 update. The project reports races and four-player play on AMD hardware. The BETA-0.2.5 prerelease offered a Linux x86-64 AppImage, and v0.2.4 offered Windows and Linux packages. Portcove has yet to qualify these packages.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare your base game and 3.0.4 update, required keys and firmware. Add DLC only if you own the corresponding content.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s Linux source launcher to generate the AppImage locally. Keep the generated game modules private. The supported Linux CPU is unconfirmed.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports 60 FPS races using ahead-of-time translation and Vulkan. NVIDIA DLSS has compiled but has no play report. Higher game rates, Windows and Android are still in development or planned.
